NaAudio__Palette__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: Single source of truth for every colour in AudioSPACE, 3D and 2D alike. The CSS custom properties in 03__Style__AppStylesheets/NaAudio__CoreUi__Styles__Variables__.css mirror this file by hand; a browser cannot read a stylesheet variable from JSON. If you change a hex here, change it there.
NaAudio__Palette__Config__Meta.DesignIntent: Kandinsky Composition A dialled a long way back. Flat geometric primitives on a warm paper ground, thin dark linework, and a small palette of muted pigments used sparingly. Nothing glossy: every surface is matte, roughness stays high and metalness stays at zero, so a shape reads as painted card rather than plastic.
NaAudio__Palette__Config__Meta.AntiGlossRule: No material in this application may have metalness above 0.0 or roughness below 0.60. Specular highlights read as a games engine and fight the flat-pigment look. Depth comes from hue and value separation, not from shine.
NaAudio__Palette__Config__Meta.ColourSpaceNote: Hexes are authored in sRGB as they would be picked in a paint program. Three.js is in colour-managed mode, so NaAudio__Env3d__PaletteLibrary passes them through THREE.Color with sRGB conversion rather than treating them as linear values.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__Ground.PaperNote: The ground everything sits on. A warm bone, not white - white makes every pigment above it read as a highlighter.
NaAudio__Palette__Config__Ground.PaperDeepNote: Horizon end of the backdrop gradient, and the floor plane away from the stage.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__Ink.InkNote: Warm near-black. Used for linework, labels and the thin outline on active shapes. Never pure #000000.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__Pigments.PigmentNote: Eight pigments, used flat. Each has a Base for the body of a shape and a Deep for its shadowed face, rim or active state. Nothing else may be introduced without removing something - the restraint is the point.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__VoiceRoles.VoiceRoleNote: A drum voice keeps its pigment wherever it appears - on a sequencer step, on a meter, on a patch cable. Colour is an identity in this application, not decoration, so the mapping lives in config and not in the module that happens to draw it first.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__SignalTypes.SignalTypeNote: Patch cable colour by what travels down it. Audio is warm, modulation is cool, trigger is dark - readable at a glance from across the space without a legend.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__StageProps.StagePropNote: The Kandinsky nod. Large flat shapes sitting far behind the working area at very low contrast, so the space reads as a composition rather than as an empty grid. They are scenery: never pickable, never audible.

NaAudio__Palette__Config__ModuleStates.ModuleStateNote: The dual-state system from the design manifest. A working module is fully lit and fully saturated; a locked module dims, desaturates and gains a visible cage on all six sides. The user must be able to tell across the room which modules are still burning CPU.
